name: Agreni Batra
bio: I am an educator, curriculum designer, and gender-and-education researcher whose work spans curriculum design, teacher learning, classroom instruction, and research across India and New York City. I earned an M.A. in Curriculum and Teaching from Teachers College, Columbia University in 2024. My thesis, Curriculum of the Body, examines the physical and emotional violence inflicted on female students in Indian schools through a Foucauldian lens. Recent work includes STEM and social justice curriculum at Girls Inc. of New York City, independent contract research on gender and curriculum for Re|Scripted, and the Media Justice for Social Change curriculum through Teachers College's Digital Futures Institute.
